winning_hook_formulas: The 'Hidden Loss' Formula: [Common Financial Product] + [Hidden Cost/Inflation] + [Emotional Consequence]
script_directives: Keep total duration strictly under 22 seconds to force high completion rates.
Eliminate fluff intros; start the hook within the first 0.5 seconds with high-contrast visual text.
Use a 'Problem-Agitation-Solution' structure where the solution is a specific, actionable data point or strategy.
seo_directives: Use high-intent keywords in the title that address specific pain points (e.g., 'Nifty', 'FD', 'Stocks').
Limit hashtags to 3-4 highly relevant tags (e.g., #FinanceShorts, #InvestingTips, #StockMarketIndia) to avoid algorithm confusion.
